column3: I'm surprised you don't find that difficult if you risk alienating them by regularly speaking words they don't understand.
TAUBE: But there go my manners again!
Welcome to my temple, guests from the future.
What are your names?
ELIAS: Ah, right, of course.
My name is...
\PN!
And my friend here is Ar...
Arcy...
Arc!
This is Arc.
TAUBE: \PN and Arc? It is lovely to meet you both.
I hope your journey through time was not arduous.
Solaris.
Solaris Brown.
And my companion here is called \PN.
TAUBE: Solaris and \PN? It is lovely to meet you both.
Now, no matter how much of a rush I am in to get home, I must see to my duties.
A Legendary Pokémon has traveled through time for my aid; it is only right to do everything I can to help.
ELIAS: My apologies again...
I panicked and just said the first name that came to mind.
Please forgive this lie, my Lord.
ELIAS: The Relic Stone...
Unfortunately, it is similarly inaccessible in our time.
However, we possessed no alternative, so I am overjoyed to hear you have one.
I presume this will be most effective if Celebi meditates on its own for a time?
TAUBE: Exactly, yes.
I apologize for the wait.
Like you no doubt are, I am quite eager to get home.
But it is important to see this through; Celebi came here for our aid.
ELIAS: It is no burden to wait for us.
I would be honored to read some of the texts you have here, in case there are some the Order was unable to preserve?
TAUBE: By all means, you are welcome to read whatever you wish.
Ah, and the entrance is just back there, Celebi. I hope you find it peaceful.
TAUBE: However, while you are of course free to look through my texts...
I must admit, I couldn't help but notice you both have Pokémon on you.
Between my responsibilities with the Order and the changes at home, the only person I can ever find the time to battle is Joseph.
Who, naturally, I'm no match for.
How can a humble priest compete with a man that traveled to Orre to conquer Mt. Battle?
And given we have time to kill... Would one of you two care for a battle?
ELIAS: Joseph... Hazel?
I have heard the name.
Your servant, if I recall correctly?
TAUBE: Ah, I see you've been studying Order doctrine.
Yes, I suppose the traditions dictate he is my servant.
But, even if he is too proud to admit it, as far as I'm concerned, he's nothing short of my closest friend.
Interesting, I see.
TAUBE: I'm sure my newborn and his young Elias will get along just as well, too.
As I said, do either of you wish to battle?
ELIAS: Newborn...?
Ah, congratulations...
I apologize; I do not quite feel up to battling at this particular moment...
But Arc is a far better trainer than I, anyway.
He has bested me, and serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
She has bested me, and serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
They have bested me, and serve as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
But \PN has beaten me once before, and would make the better challenge.
He serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
She serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
They serve as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
TAUBE: A Champion of sorts?
I hope in the future the Order does not have a need for somebody to defend us as such.
But it is nice to know we have talented trainers on our side, nonetheless.
You are free to look around, of course,
But speak to me when you wish to battle, Champion of the Future.
ELIAS: ...Newborn.
So he was just born...
And I am still a child, still without sight.
Taube and my father were... friends?
Pardon me; I have been given much to consider.
It's a book where visitors to the temple can write their thoughts.
It's page after page of people thanking Taube for his hard work for the people and Pokémon of the region.
There's a small note scribbled on the very last page.
I'm really glad I met you.
It's Taka's handwriting.
TAUBE: The poor Pokémon...
But I have every faith you can bring it back to its senses.
TAUBE: Ah, hello again, Champion of the Future.
I have good news and bad news.
The good news is Celebi was able to attract a number of its Temporal Fragments.
The bad news is, those fragments appear to not be too friendly.
That poor Pokémon looks like it's about to go on a rampage!
I hate to ask this of you after we just battled-- but my Pokémon are in no condition to fight.
And a battle should tire Celebi out enough to bring it back to its senses!
You should have no trouble with this after that showing before though.
I'm sure Celebi believes in you too. Go on ahead.
TAUBE: It was my honor to meet you both.
May Arceus make your journey home a safe one.
TAUBE: It was a pleasure to meet you both.
TAKA: I guess we go back home after you get Celebi under control?
...It's a shame that this place was replaced by the League.
I wonder what happened to all these plants...
TAKA: When he said he had a garden down here, I wasn't expecting a full orchard!
There's enough fruit on these trees to feed like, a whole city.
I guess everyone in my family has done great things but me...
ELIAS: My Lord; I know you can bring this poor Pokémon's mind back to peace.
I know you would not allow a creature to suffer for a moment longer than is necessary.
ELIAS: I had always remembered this place as the most beautiful garden in the world.
I admit, part of me assumed that was just the nostalgia of having spent much time here as a child.
But clearly this place is just as grand as I recall.
TAKA: ...We should go now...
ELIAS: Solaris was a codename; Phoenix was his real...
Ah, but of course, you know all this.
Anyway, Celebi can move through time, but not space.
This garden is approximately located where the second Elite Four chamber is; thus Celebi should bring us back to our time in the third.
Conveniently, that is my own.
I am ready to leave when you are, my Lord.
A detailed handwritten encyclopedia of Legendary Pokémon.
The drawings are brilliant, but the handwriting is abysmal.
It's a stack of complicated-looking religious textbooks.
In the middle of the stack appears to be a magazine of some sort?
'Dragon Tamer Monthly: Don't Miss Our Tell-All Interview with Joseph Hazel!'
...This interview is so dull it makes the textbooks look like appealing reading.
A short book titled 'Gardening and You: How to Use Your Bug Types to Ingrain Your Crops and Double Your Growth!'
Somebody has expertly doodled a Ribombee on many of the pages.

SHELLY: Ready to battle?
SHELLY: Perfect.
I have a pretty incredible Elite Four, so I rarely even get challengers.
And when I do, I have no trouble beating them.
So let's go, \PN.
Remind me what a REAL battle feels like!
SHELLY: 10 years of training and I'm still not quite on your level?
Phenomenal, absolutely phenomenal...
That was an incredibly fun battle.
I suppose now I should tell you about the last bit of my research--
The Relic Stone is self-correcting.
It's tied close enough to Celebi that it's attuned to the timestream.
So if I just give you this one to take back with you, that should all be fine--
It'll just get rid of the one in your time still stuck in the New World.
Which... You're welcome, you not having to grab it yourself.
It was a real pain trying to figure out how to get it.
How about I fly us all to Agate City, we can say "Hi" to a few people there, and then Celebi can take you two and the Relic Stone back to your time?
TAKA: That... sounds nice.
And... thanks.
This has been a pretty weird day.
SHELLY: Don't mention it.
Just be extra nice to me 10 years ago when I'm still coming out of my shell, and we can call it even!
Just talk to me when you're ready to go!
SHELLY: Take your time to get ready.
I don't want anything less than your best!
ELIAS: Seeing how people are doing here, in this future?
...I would like that.
Thank you for your help, and being such a gracious host, Champion.
SHELLY: Time to leave, is it?
Everybody will be excited to see you both after so long!
I'll fly us there!
SHELLY: We had a wonderful time in Agate.
Everyone was so excited to see you after 10 years!
So many people have changed so much.
And the look on El's face when he found out who my Elite Four are was priceless!
And the look on Taka's face when he found out who my Elite Four are was priceless!
...But even the best days can't last forever.
I know you need to head back to your own time.
I'm sure you could spend forever in Agate, talking to everyone and seeing what they're doing now.
SHELLY: ...But don't you think that's a story for another time?
SHELLY: Oh, and \PN?
Even if you'll be there to defend it in your timeline...
SHELLY: Watch your back-- I'm coming for your title!
CELEBI: Biiiiiii!!!!!
Sensing the Relic Stone, Celebi rushed ahead.
TAKA: This room has pretty unique decor...
Well, lead the way.
We have a Champion to meet.
ELIAS: The decoration of this room...
Oh dear.
I think I'll stay behind you while we meet the Champion.
Celebi is excitedly flying around the Relic Stone!
Celebi is clapping after watching two Champions battle!
CHAMPION: So, you've finally returned.
Welcome back, Taka and \PN.
Welcome back, Elias and \PN.
CHAMPION: Do you like what I've done with the place?
I took some cues from my old Gym.
CHAMPION: At first, people were at a loss of what to do without you.
But sometimes people need to take charge of their own destiny.
CHAMPION: And it all turned out pretty well.
Reborn is thriving.
We've established connections with many other regions, and have grown into a global center for research and battle.
CHAMPION: But that doesn't mean you weren't missed.
I may not have always shown it, but I enjoyed the time I spent with both of you.
CHAMPION: But that doesn't mean your absence wasn't felt.
Reborn lost two of its best trainers when you vanished.
CHAMPION: There I go, getting sentimental.
Over the last ten years, I've learned to open up to all of my wonderful friends.
And I'm glad to see two more are back in my life.
CHAMPION: But of course, you're more than just trainers.
You're people that have been missed.
I wasn't always the best at expressing my emotions in the past, but...
I'm very happy to see you again, \PN.
CHAMPION SHELLY: \PN, Taka. Hey!
So, what do you think? Too much?
I mean, I love being surrounded by trees, and Tania got me really into fairytales these last ten years...
So it seemed just right!
TAKA: Wait, Shelly?
You're...
Not exactly who I expected.
But uh... Hey yourself.
I like it; this place looks nice.
SHELLY: I'm glad you like it!
So, let's compare notes real quick.
You found Celebi, presumably injured in the creation of the New World.
You attempted to nurse it back to health, but realized its injuries were too complex for normal medicine.
And then you proceeded to jump through time with Celebi, trying to find a solution.
And now you're here, no doubt because Celebi was drawn by the Relic Stone?
How'd I do, miss anything?
TAKA: That's... pretty spot on, actually.
How'd you know all that?
SHELLY: Well, even after becoming Champion, I couldn't just rest on my laurels.
Between improving infrastructure and making connections with other regions...
I've been studying!
Legendary Pokémon, in particular. Including Celebi.
And I just tried to predict how Celebi would behave.
TAKA: That's... really cool.
So you're like, Reborn's Champion AND Professor?
SHELLY: Gosh, you flatter me!
But no, I'm not a Professor.
I won't have the official qualification until the end of the year.
But enough about me, come over here!
You'll want to see this!
SHELLY: Ta~daa!
One Relic Stone, straight from the New World,
And one happy healthy Celebi, fully recovered!
However, before you can all go back to your time, I'm afraid there is one slight problem with all this.
TAKA: Oh no... Did we mess up the timeline somehow?
SHELLY: Don't be silly!
You've done a great job, I'm sure.
No, the problem is simple.
I never got to fight the previous Champion when I claimed my title.
Of course, we've battled before, and I lost.
But I'm a whole different trainer now.
So let's see how that battle would've gone.
Let me know when you're ready!
TAKA: Y'know, I'm kind of glad I'm not you.
At least everyone isn't desperate to battle me.
Uh, good luck!
CHAMPION SHELLY: \PN, Elias. Hello!
ELIAS: Oh my, you're the Bug Type Gym Leader, correct?
Thank heavens it's you and not...
I was concerned I was about to get stabbed.
SHELLY: I mean, I AM still pretty steamed you used your nepotism powers to get the OTHER awkward Bug Type Trainer an Elite Four spot instead of me.
So maybe you still are.
ELIAS: I...
SHELLY: Kidding!
ELIAS: That was very impressive...
I do believe you have covered everything.
SHELLY: I'm happy to hear it.
Even after becoming Champion, I couldn't just rest on my laurels.
ELIAS: I clearly underestimated you, Shelly.
I had believed that without my Lord's guidance, surely the region would fall into disarray once more.
...Father Taube had faith in the people of Reborn.
I clearly have yet to learn all I need to from him.
SHELLY: Taube, you say?
Gosh, did you meet him while traveling through time?
How exciting! I would have loved the opportunity to learn from him.
Forgive me, but how do you know who Taube is?
SHELLY: As I mentioned, I spent a lot of time researching Legendary Pokémon.
Taube Alcantara is probably one of the foremost scholars of Legendary Pokémon to have ever lived!
It took a lot of work to find his writings, but they were a treasure trove of knowledge once I did!
And not just for my research, either; there were manuscripts detailing previously unknown history of Reborn, as well as details of lost traditions.
Finding something like that...
Well, as Champion, I had a responsibility to research further.
I've been doing my best to help the region reconnect with its history.
ELIAS: That's...
SHELLY: Oh, but there I go again, on and on about my research.
Follow me; you'll both want to see this!
ELIAS: This future is... wonderful.
The Alcantara family line has ended, and I am solely responsible.
That is a burden I will never stop carrying.
And yet... the future is bright.
The Order's teachings live on.
The Champion of Reborn is teaching the people to remember and respect the old ways...
Thank you for showing me this, my Lord.
Truly; it means...
ELIAS: Such an accomplished Champion...
But you're missing one key accomplishment.
SHELLY: Exactly.
ELIAS: My Lord smiles on me today.
For I suspect I am about to witness the greatest battle this region has ever seen.
TAKA: Even without you, things have turned out pretty great...
I guess Reborn really is filled with great people.
ELIAS: ...When we get back, I'm going to get in touch with the Fairy Leader.
I need to apologize for manipulating xem under the Grand Stairway.
And... maybe there's value in talking to somebody else who remembers the old days of the region...
TAKA: Nearly home now.
I wonder who'll be in Agate City?
I wonder if they missed me...
No, sorry,
Taube wouldn't like me talking like that.
Neither would anyone we've met today, really.
So, um...
I hope they didn't miss us too much.
ELIAS: 10 years is a rather long time.
I hope long enough that those with a frostier opinion of me have had time to... thaw.
I don't wish for hostility towards me to dampen your enjoyment of the experience-- no matter how well earned that hostility may be.

FLORINIA: Greetings.
I received a report of a kind of unknown machinery located here, and so I thought it might be prudent to investigate.
After a thorough analysis, it appears that this panel's primary purpose is to scan and inspect gathered Z- Cells.
At the moment, it does not appear as if collecting all 50 Z-Cells is a necessity, although it may be in the future.
It appears that for every 10 Z-Cells brought here, another gate will open.
It can probably be assumed that behind all of these, there exists a way to fuse the cells into a 100% Zygarde.
...I did try to hack the system, but unfortunately all of the usual methods appear ineffective.
I am struggling to find any similarities to modern back-end infrastructures in these machines.
It is as if they are only made to look like common devices, rather than actually being them.
One might say that it is slightly frustrating.
However, I am admittedly a bit curious as to how it works still, so I plan to remain here just a while longer and continue trying.
